name: Koibito wa Senzoku SP
source:
The protagonist was walking in the city and the large outdoor TV monitor showed a newly announced young prime minister. She thought it had nothing to do with her since she leads a normal life. But she was mistaken. A strange man held a gun to her telling her to keep quiet. Not knowing what the strange man really wants, she struggles and luckily is rescued by a lady named Sora who seems to know her.

The strange man took off. Not long after that a helicopter came and Sora asked the protagonist to go with her. Just when she thought things couldn't get any more interesting, there were two men in suits on the helicopter. One who glared at her and one who startled her with caramel tea.

Without much explanation, they soon arrived at the parliament house. That's when the new prime minister greets her and tells her that she is actually his daughter and it seems that she's now being targeted for this very reason. So to ensure her safety, she'll have to choose one of these men to protect her 24/7!

[adapted from [url=http://gratefullove.blog126.fc2.com/blog-entry-46.html]Nabari no Blog[/url]]
translation:
女主角正走在城市街头，户外巨型电视屏上则播放着一位年轻首相刚刚上任的新闻。她觉得这一切和过着平凡生活的自己毫无关系。可她错了。

一名陌生男子突然用枪指着她，命令她保持安静。她不知道男子究竟有何企图，只能拼命挣扎。幸运的是，一名叫广末空的女性及时现身，将她救了下来。而且，空似乎还认识她。

陌生男子转身逃走。没过多久，一架直升机便抵达现场，空请女主角与自己一同登机。当她觉得事态已经不可能变得更加离奇时，又在机上看到了两名西装男子。其中一人正神色不善地瞪着她，另一人则突然端出了焦糖红茶，把她吓了一跳。

没有得到太多解释，一行人很快便抵达国会议事堂。新任首相在那里亲自迎接她，并告诉她，她其实是自己的女儿。也正因这层身份，她如今已成为某些人的目标。为了确保她的安全，她必须从这些男人中选出一人，每天24小时贴身保护自己！

[改编自[url=http://gratefullove.blog126.fc2.com/blog-entry-46.html]Nabari no Blog[/url]]
